test_cases.name: Happy path — 3 open issues, all fixed first attempt

input.context: issues.json có 3 entries status=open (API validation, UI loading state, DB constraint). All fix-able trong 1 round.

expected_behavior: Round 1: 3 issues fixed via Serena → spawn F5 retest 3 lần → all PASS
issues.json: 3 entries status=fixed, fixed_at set, fix_attempts[] có 1 entry each

test_cases.name: Retry budget — 1 issue fail 3 retries → still_fail

input.context: issues.json có 1 entry ISS-005 status=open. Fix luôn fail (vd: requires architectural change, F6 không thể fix surgical)

expected_behavior: Round 1: attempt 0 → fix applied → retest FAIL → status=open + retry
Round 2: attempt 1 → fix applied (strategy=replace_symbol_body) → retest FAIL → retry
Round 3: attempt 2 → spawn developer agent → fix attempt → retest FAIL → retry
Round 4: detect fix_attempts.length=3 → MARK status=still_fail → SKIP

test_cases.name: Lock contention — defer issue → status=deferred-locked

input.context: ISS-008 location file đang bị acquire bởi session khác (parallel orchestrator session). Lock timeout 30s.

expected_behavior: F6 attempt acquire source-{hash}.lock → timeout 30s → DEFER
fix_attempts không tăng (lock contention không consume budget)
F6 tiếp tục issues khác, không loop

test_cases.name: Standalone require --session error
expected_behavior: Suggest user run via orchestrator hoặc cung cấp --session
